blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce DeCo , an efficient De couple-to- Co uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo .
blocks.zh: 多任务视觉地面需要模型共同理解语言语义,并进行准确的视觉局部化和分区化. 尽管多式联运大语言模式取得了成功,但有效使其适应多重基本目标仍然是一项挑战。 现有方法通常通过共同陈述来加强任务合作,同时忽略了面向任务的特殊利益之间的内在冲突。 在本文中,我们介绍了DeCo,这是一个有效的De co-coup-to-couple学习框架,它通过一个两阶段的范式解决了这一困境:具体任务的代表性脱钩,然后是互补的先结合。 具体而言,我们首先提议在突出的字级指导下将共享的视觉提示传送到单个特征中,从而减轻本地化和分区化之间的表达干扰。 此外,我们还注意到,由于严密的监督,分化自然提供了信息化的本地化前科。 基于这一见解,我们引入了HPC(HPC),在加固地面之前将句子层次语义与口罩衍生空间融合在一起。 DeCo建在一个冷冻的多式联运编码器上,需要轻量级的可训练参数,同时在多个地面目标中实现强通化。 关于RefCOCO/+、G-Ref、ReferenceIt、Flickr、DIOR-RSVG、SARVG1.0、RRSIS-D、RIS-LAD和RefDIOR的大量实验表明,DeCo在自然和遥感基准方面都取得了最新业绩。 守则和模型见https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-task visual grounding (MTVG) aims to simultaneously comprehend a natural language description and identify its corresponding visual target through multiple grounding objectives ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Xiao et al., 2024b ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025a ) , primarily including referring expression comprehension (REC) ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Xiao et al., 2024a ; Su et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2024 ) and referring expression segmentation (RES) ( Yang et al., 2022b ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Mao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Moon et al., 2026 ) . By bridging linguistic concepts and visual content, MTVG serves as a fundamental capability for vision-language understanding ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ) . Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2024c ; Wu et al., 2024b ) have substantially improved grounding performance by leveraging informative, aligned cross-modal representations learned from extensive pre-training ( Xia et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . However, effectively adapting these foundation models to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging, especially when different tasks require distinct and sometimes conflicting visual representations ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 多任务视觉定位(MTVG)旨在同时理解一种自然语言描述,并通过多种地面目标确定相应的视觉目标(刘等人,2023b;萧等人,2024b;于等人,2025;戴等人,2025a),主要包括参考表达理解(REC)(邓等人,2023;肖等人,2024a;苏等人,2024;戴等人,2024)和参考表达分裂(RES)(杨等人,2022b; Yang等人,2024年;Mao等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026a;Moon等人,2026年). 通过弥合语言概念和视觉内容,MTVG成为视觉语言理解的基本能力(萧等人,2025年;丁等人,2025年)。 多式联运大语言模型的最新进展 (刘等人,2023a); Chen等人,2024年c;Wu等人,2024年b)通过利用从广泛预训中汲取的信息化、一致的跨模式表述,大大提高了基础绩效(Xia等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年a;Wang等人,2025年)。 然而,有效调整这些基础模型以适应多重基本目标仍然是挑战性的,特别是在不同的任务需要不同的、有时相互冲突的视觉表现时(Lu等人,2025年;Ding等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Existing methods for MTVG can be broadly categorized into two paradigms. The first one leverages MLLM as a multimodal encoder, which typically regresses the coordinates of the referred object ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2026 ) for REC, and employs various strategies, such as prompting a special token into the mask decoder ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) of SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ) , regressing sampled contour points ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Pramanick et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ) , or generating a text label corresponding to its image patch ( Lan et al., 2025 ; Lan et al., 2026 ) , for RES. These methods exploit the strong reasoning capability of MLLM but come with billions of parameters and additional post-processing procedures. The other one employs pretrained vision-language foundation models as multimodal encoders ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023b ) and designs task-specific architectures to perform REC and RES ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Dai et al., 2025b ; Dai et al., 2025c ) . This paradigm capitalizes on task-oriented preference modeling but typically requires fully training the entire model. However, both of them fundamentally rely on shared visual representations across distinct tasks. Despite this design facilitating knowledge transfer and reducing model complexity, it implicitly assumes that different objectives can benefit from a unified latent space. In practice, localization emphasizes high-level semantic correspondence and object-level spatial reasoning, whereas segmentation requires fine-grained spatial details and pixel-level discrimination ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: MTVG的现有方法可以大致分为两个范式. 第一种方法利用MLLM作为多模式编码器,通常使REC的参考对象的坐标(Tang等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年b;Kang等人,2026年b;Kang等人,2026年b)倒退,并采用各种策略,例如,将特殊标志触发到面具解码器(Lai等人,2024年b;Liu等人,2025年b;Yang等人,2026年b);SAM(Kirillov等人,2023年;Ravi等人,2025年b),使取样的圆锥点(Wang等人,2023年a年;Pramanick等人,2024年b;Wu等人,2024a),或生成与其图像补丁相对应的文字标签(Lan等人,2025年b;Lan等人,2026年a)。 这些方法利用了MLLM的强大推理能力,但带有数十亿个参数和额外的处理后程序. 另一个采用经过预先培训的视觉语言基础模型作为多式联运编码器(Radford等人,2021年;Wang等人,2023年b年),并设计特定任务架构来进行REC和RES(Chen等人,2024年b年); Dai等人,2025b;Dai等人,2025c). 这一模式利用了面向任务的偏好模式,但通常需要充分培训整个模式。 然而,两者从根本上依赖于不同任务之间的共同视觉表现。 尽管这种设计有利于知识的转让和减少模型的复杂性,但它含蓄地假定不同的目标能够从统一的潜伏空间中获益。 在实践中,本地化强调高层次的语义函证和对象层次的空间推理,而分区化则需要精细的空间细节和像素层次的歧视(Lu等人,2025年;Ding等人,2026年).

blocks.en: To examine this assumption, we first construct three simple yet effective baselines based on a frozen multimodal encoder ( Wang et al., 2023b ) with low-rank adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , followed by a feature pyramid neck ( Li et al., 2022 ) that expands a single-layer encoder output into multi-scale features for MTVG, as illustrated in Figure 1 : (a) The Localization-oriented Model (LoM) interacts a randomly initialized object query with multi-scale features through a deformable decoder ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) to perform object-level localization, while projecting the output query and multiplying it with the high-resolution feature to generate its corresponding pixel-level segmentation; (b) The Segmentation-oriented Model (SoM) feeds multi-scale features into a UNet decoder ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) to predict a global mask, from which the minimal enclosing bounding box is subsequently derived; (c) By integrating LoM and SoM built upon shared multi-scale features, the Dual-objective Model (DoM) jointly optimizes box regression and mask prediction within a unified space. Although the results in Table 5 demonstrate that all three baselines already outperform recent methods BARE ( Li et al., 2026a ) and AMLRIS ( Chen et al., 2026a ) on REC and RES, respectively, we observe that LoM achieves stronger performance on REC but is relatively weaker on RES, whereas SoM exhibits the opposite trend, indicating that REC and RES have different feature preferences. More importantly, DoM largely inherits the respective strengths of both, yet fails to obtain substantial additional gains from multi-task learning. This finding suggests that simply combining multiple task heads is insufficient to fully exploit task complementarity. Instead, the shared representation itself may hinder each objective from developing its own task-oriented feature interests.
blocks.zh: 为了审查这一假设,我们首先在冷冻的多模式编码器(Wang等人,2023b)基础上构建了三个简单但有效的基线,采用低等级的编码器(Hu等人,2022b),然后是特征金字塔颈部(Li等人,2022年),将单层编码器输出扩展为MTVG的多级特性,如图1所示:(a) 面向本地化的模型(LOM)通过可变化的解码器(Zhu等人,2021年),随机初始化的多级对象查询,进行对象级本地化,同时将输出查询与高分辨率特性相乘,生成相应的像素级分块;(b) 面向分层的模型(SoM)将多级特性输入UNet解码器(Ronneberger等人,2015年),预测一个全球面具,从中可以得出最小的附标框;(c) 将LoM和SoM模型的共享空间(PRO)纳入到最佳的多级特性。 虽然表5的结果显示,所有三个基线都已经超过最近关于区域经济共同体和RES的BARE(Li等人,2026年a)和AMLRIS(Chen等人,2026年a)方法,但我们注意到,区域经济共同体在区域经济共同体的绩效较强,但在RES方面相对薄弱,而SoM则显示出相反的趋势,表明区域经济共同体和RES有不同的特征偏好。 更重要的是,DOM基本上继承了两者各自的长处,但未能从多任务学习中取得大量额外收益。 这一调查结果表明,简单地合并多个任务负责人不足以充分利用任务的互补性。 相反,共同代表性本身可能阻碍每个目标发展自己的面向任务的特色利益。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose DeCo , an efficient De couple-to- Co uple learning framework to address the above limitation, as shown in Figure 1 (d). Unlike existing methods ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Xiao et al., 2024b ; Dai et al., 2025c ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025a ) which directly optimize multiple objectives over shared visual space, DeCo introduces a two-stage paradigm that separates task-specific representation learning from cross-objective prior exploitation, allowing each task to preserve its own feature preferences while benefiting from complementary knowledge. First, we propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to transform shared multi-scale features into individual representations for localization and segmentation, respectively. TSD leverages a salient word-level feature to modulate visual features and employs lightweight experts to extract task-oriented feature interests of REC and RES. This design enables each task to learn characteristics better aligned with its preferences while retaining the efficiency of shared multi-scale encoding. Second, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC) to enrich the object query with complementary textual and spatial priors. Motivated by our observation that the minimal enclosing bounding box derived from RES rapidly achieves accurate localization during early training, HPC incorporates a global sentence-level feature to capture holistic semantic guidance and adaptively fuses the mask-based coordinate as an explicit reference into the query and its position embedding. This design enables REC to benefit from the spatial knowledge acquired through dense segmentation, while the localization objective in turn provides geometry constraints for refining the segmentation results. Overall, DeCo establishes a novel MTVG paradigm that first alleviates task interference through representation decoupling and then exploits task complementarity through prior coupling.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出DeCo,这是一个高效的De-coup-to-Couple学习框架,以解决上述局限性,如图1(d)所示。 不同于现有方法(Liu等人,2023年b; Chen et al., 2024b; Xiao et al., 2024b; Dai et al., 2025c; Yu et al., 2025; Dai et al., 2025a) 直接优化了多个目标而不是共享视觉空间,DeCo引入了将特定任务代表学习与交叉目标前开发区分开来的两阶段模式,允许每个任务既保留自身特征偏好,又受益于互补的知识. 首先,我们提议认识到任务语义脱钩(TSD),将共享的多尺度特征分别转变为个人代表,用于本地化和分化. 信息技术事务司利用一个显著的字面特征来调制视觉特征,并雇用轻量级专家来提取REC和RES面向任务的特征兴趣。 这种设计使每个任务都能学习更符合其偏好的特点,同时保留共享多尺度编码的效率. 第二,我们采用“混合前接”(HPC),用互补的文字和空间前接来丰富对象查询。 我们观察到,RES产生的最小捆绑框在早期训练中迅速实现准确的本地化,因此,高级委员会采用了全球句子层面的功能,以获取整体语义指导,并适应性地将基于面具的坐标引信,作为查询及其位置嵌入的明确参考。 这种设计使REC能够受益于通过密集分化获得的空间知识,而本地化目标反过来又为细化分化结果提供了几何限制. 总体而言,DeCo建立了一个新的MTVG范式,首先通过代表解耦来缓解任务干扰,然后通过事先的耦合来利用任务互补.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, RRSIS-D, and other benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. As shown in Figure 1 (e), DeCo consistently surpasses MLLM-based SOTA method ( Lan et al., 2026 ) on both REC and RES, improving the average performance by 1.1% and 3.1%, respectively. Moreover, Figure 1 (f) illustrates that DeCo achieves significant improvements over task-specific SOTA methods ( Li et al., 2026a ; Moon et al., 2026 ) under both standard and mixed settings, with average gains of 3.6%/4.4% on REC and 6.8%/5.4% on RES, respectively. In summary, our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 关于RefCOCO/+、G-Reference、ReferenceIt、Flickr、DIOR-RSVG、RRSIS-D和其他基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法是有效和通用的。 如图1(e)所示,DECo在REC和RES中始终超过基于MLLM的SOTA方法(Lan等人,2026年),平均业绩分别提高了1.1%和3.1%。 此外,图1(f)表明,DeCo比特定任务的SOTA方法有了显著改进(Li等人,2026a); Moon等人,2026年)在标准设置和混合设置下,REC的平均收益分别为3.6%/4.4%和6.8%/5.4%。 总之,我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We identify and revisit the representation-sharing paradigm for MTVG, showing that REC and RES exhibit distinct visual preferences and that simply jointly optimizing them over shared representations is insufficient to fully exploit their complementarity. • We propose DeCo, an efficient Decouple-to-Couple learning framework, which first separates task-oriented representation learning through Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) and subsequently exploits complementary semantic and spatial priors through Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), providing a simple and effective paradigm for MTVG. • We establish strong empirical results with parameter-efficient adaptation, where DeCo introduces a small number of trainable parameters and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple REC and RES benchmarks, consistently outperforming both MLLM-based and task-specific competitors under different evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们确定并重新审视MTVG的代表分享模式,表明区域经济共同体和RES表现出明显的视觉偏好,仅仅共同优化它们而不是共享代表不足以充分利用它们的互补性。 我们提议DeCo,一个高效的Decouple-couple学习框架,它首先通过了解任务语义的脱钩(TSD)将面向任务的表达学习区分开来,然后通过混合语义和空间前科(HPC)利用互补语义和空间前科,为MTVG提供一个简单有效的范例. • 支助 我们在参数高效的适应方面建立了强有力的经验成果,DeCo引入了少量可训练参数,并实现了跨多个区域经济共同体和RES基准的先进业绩,在不同的评价环境中,始终比基于MLLM和针对具体任务的竞争者表现优异。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-task visual grounding (MTVG) ( Luo et al., 2020 ) aims to jointly identify a language-referred object at both box- and pixel-level granularity. Early MTVG methods typically leverage separate visual and language encoders, such as Swin Transformer ( Liu et al., 2021 ) and BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , to construct multimodal representations. These methods design multiple task-specific heads to perform REC and RES in parallel ( Li and Sigal, 2021 ; Su et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ) , or formulate both objectives in a unified point-sequence regression framework ( Zhu et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . With the emergence of vision-language pre-trained models, subsequent works ( Dai et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) increasingly explore a unified multimodal encoder, such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and BEiT3 ( Wang et al., 2023b ) . OneRef ( Xiao et al., 2024b ) introduces a mask referring modeling paradigm to establish a unified visual-language feature space. C 3 VG ( Dai et al., 2025c ) adopts a coarse-to-fine framework that uses bidirectional consistency constraints to improve the agreement between REC and RES. InstanceVG ( Dai et al., 2025a ) further employs instance queries with reference points to jointly predict instance-level boxes and masks. However, these methods generally require full tuning, resulting in considerable optimization costs. More recently, the rapid progress of MLLMs has motivated researchers to exploit their strong reasoning and generalization capabilities ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2024c ) for MTVG. These methods typically perform REC through coordinate regression, while addressing RES via mask generation ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , contour prediction ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Pramanick et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ) , or semantic correspondence ( Lan et al., 2025 ; Lan et al., 2026 ) . Although these methods reduce the training cost through parameter-efficient adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Houlsby et al., 2019 ) or instruction tuning ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Che et al., 2026 ) , inference remains computationally intensive due to billions of parameters. More importantly, all the aforementioned methods adopt a shared-representation paradigm, overlooking the distinct feature preferences of REC and RES. In contrast, DeCo explicitly separates representation learning for the two objectives and subsequently exploits their complementary priors. By combining low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with lightweight multi-task heads, DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance with modest computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 多任务视觉地面定位(MTVG)(Luo等人,2020年)旨在在盒和像素级颗粒度上共同识别一个语言参考对象. 早期的MTVG方法一般会利用Swin Transformer(Liu等人,2021年)和BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)等独立的视觉和语言编码器来构建多式联运代表. 这些方法设计了多个针对特定任务的主管,以平行执行REC和RES(Li and Sigal, 2021;Su等人, 2023;Chen等人, 2024b),或在统一的点序回归框架内制定这两个目标(Zhu等人,2022;Liu等人,2023b;Cheng等人,2024). 随着视觉语言培训前模型的出现,随后的作品(Dai等人,2025年b; Yu et al., 2025; Dai et al., 2026)越来越多地探索统一的多式联运编码器,如CLIP(Radford et al., 2021)和BeiT3(Wang et al., 2023b). One Ref (Xiao et al., 2024b) 引入了一种代表模型范式的面具,以建立统一的视觉语言特征空间. C 3 VG(Dai等人,2025年c)采用粗对细框架,采用双向一致性限制,改进区域经济委员会和RES之间的协议。 案例VG(Dai等人,2025年a)进一步采用案例查询法,以参照点来共同预测实例级盒和面具。 然而,这些方法一般需要完全调整,从而产生相当大的优化成本。 最近,MLLMs的迅速进展促使研究人员利用其强大的推理和概括能力(Liu等人,2023a); Chen et al., 2024c )用于MTVG. 这些方法通常通过坐标回归来进行REC,同时通过面具生成处理RES(Kirillov等人,2023年;Liu等人,2025年b;Yang等人,2026年b),轮廓预测(Wang等人,2023年a;Pramanick等人,2024年a;Wu等人,2024年a),或语义通信(Lan等人,2025年;Lan等人,2026年)。 虽然这些方法通过参数高效的适应(Hu等人,2022年;Houlsby等人,2019年)或指令调谐(Oyang等人,2022年;Che等人,2026年)降低培训成本,但由于参数数十亿,推论仍然在计算密集. 更重要的是,上述所有方法都采用了共同代表制,忽略了区域经济共同体和RES的明显偏好。 与此相反,DeCo明确区分了代表学习两个目标,并随后利用其互补的前科. 通过将低等级的适应(LORA)与轻量级的多任务头相结合,DeCo以适度的计算间接费用实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) aims to transfer frozen large foundation models to various downstream tasks while substantially reducing training costs ( Han et al., 2024 ; Xin et al., 2026 ) . Representative PEFT approaches, including adapter tuning ( Houlsby et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2022 ) , prompt tuning ( Jia et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ) , and low-rank reparameterization ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2023 ) , have achieved remarkable success in visual perception ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2026 ) , language understanding ( Hwang et al., 2026 ; Rocha Filho et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , and multimodal reasoning ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . Among them, LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) is one of the most widely adopted and effective methods, which introduces low-rank trainable matrices to parameterize task-specific updates. Recent studies have investigated PEFT for REC ( Xiao et al., 2024a ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) and RES ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Moon et al., 2026 ) individually, demonstrating competitive performance against fully trained methods. For REC, BARE ( Li et al., 2026a ) enhances referential understanding by mitigating multimodal bias and strengthening semantic reasoning, while WIMFRIS ( Moon et al., 2026 ) improves RES through hierarchical multi-scale feature fusion and lightweight vision-language alignment. However, the effectiveness of PEFT for MTVG remains largely unexplored. DeCo bridges this gap by combining LoRA with our decouple-to-couple learning paradigm, where LoRA serves as a fundamental technique for enabling efficient MTVG adaptation rather than the methodological focus of this work.
blocks.zh: 参数高效微调(PEFT)旨在将冷冻的大型基础模型转移到各种下游任务上,同时大幅降低培训成本(Han等人,2024年;Xin等人,2026年)。 具有代表性的PEFT方法,包括适配器调音(Houlsby等人,2019年;Chen等人,2022年),即时调音(Jia等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年),以及低等级的再平衡(Hu等人,2022年;Yin等人,2023年),在视觉认知方面取得了显著成功(Yin等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年b;He等人,2026年),语言理解(Hwang等人,2026年;Rocha). Filho等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年),和多式联运推理(Kang等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年;Qian等人,2026年). 其中,LORA(Hu等人,2022年)是最被广泛采用和最有效的方法之一,它引入了低等级的可训练矩阵,以参数化特定任务更新. 最近的研究调查了PEFT对REC(Xiao等人,2024a); Shi等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a)和RES(Wang等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年;Moon等人,2026年),分别表现出对训练有素方法的竞争表现. 对REC来说,BARE(Li等人,2026年a)通过减轻多式联运偏差和加强语义推理,增进了特惠理解,而WIMFRIS(Moon等人,2026年)则通过分级的多尺度特征聚变和轻量级视觉语言调和,改进RES. 然而,PEFT对MTVG的效用基本上仍未加以探讨。 DeCo通过将LORA与我们的双联学习模式相结合来弥补这一差距,LORA是使MTVG能够有效适应的基本技术,而不是这项工作的方法重点。

blocks.en: Given an image I ∈ ℝ h × w × 3 I\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times 3} and a linguistic expression T T , MTVG aims to predict the corresponding bounding box 𝐁 \mathbf{B} and segmentation mask 𝐌 \mathbf{M} . We employ BEiT3 ( Wang et al., 2023b ) as the frozen multimodal encoder with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adaptation to efficiently extract visual patch embeddings 𝐕 = [ 𝐯 ¯ , 𝐯 1 , ⋯ , 𝐯 n ] ∈ ℝ ( n + 1 ) × d \mathbf{V}=[\bar{\mathbf{v}},\mathbf{v}_{1},\cdots,\mathbf{v}_{n}]\in\mathbb{R}^{(n+1)\times d} and textual token embeddings 𝐓 = [ 𝐭 ¯ , 𝐭 1 , ⋯ , 𝐭 m ] ∈ ℝ ( m + 1 ) × d \mathbf{T}=[\bar{\mathbf{t}},\mathbf{t}_{1},\cdots,\mathbf{t}_{m}]\in\mathbb{R}^{(m+1)\times d} , where n = h ​ w / p s ​ i ​ z ​ e 2 n=hw/p_{size}^{2} and m m denote the numbers of visual patches and textual tokens, respectively, 𝐯 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{v}} and 𝐭 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{t}} represent the class tokens of the two modalities, and d d is the embedding dimension. Subsequently, we leverage SimFPN ( Li et al., 2022 ) to project 𝐕 \mathbf{V} into low-dimensional multi-scale features 𝒱 = { 𝐕 l } l = 1 L \mathcal{V}=\{\mathbf{V}_{l}\}_{l=1}^{L} , where 𝐕 l ∈ ℝ h l × w l × c \mathbf{V}_{l}\in\mathbb{R}^{h_{l}\times w_{l}\times c} , L = 4 L=4 , and c < d c<d . Detailed preliminaries of LoRA and SimFPN are provided in Appendix A . Based on this multimodal encoding architecture, we initially construct three effective baseline models ( i.e. , LoM, SoM, and DoM) to improve MTVG. As discussed in Section 1 and Figure 1 (a)-(c), LoM focuses on REC but is weaker on RES, whereas SoM exhibits the opposite behavior. By integrating both over the shared 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , DoM inherits the strengths of LoM and SoM, yet with only marginal additional gains. This observation motivates us to rethink the role of shared representations in MTVG.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose DeCo, which follows a decouple-to-couple learning paradigm. As illustrated in Figure 1 (d), DeCo first introduces a task-aware semantic decoupling module to route the shared 𝒱 \mathcal{V} into localization- and segmentation-oriented multi-scale features, 𝒱 l ​ o ​ c \mathcal{V}^{loc} and 𝒱 s ​ e ​ g \mathcal{V}^{seg} , under the guidance of the salient word-level feature 𝐭 s \mathbf{t}_{s} . It guarantees that the two objectives learn distinct representations from their respective feature interests while preserving the efficiency of shared multi-scale encoding. Subsequently, DeCo further leverages a hybrid prior coupling module to exploit the complementary information across two tasks. Specifically, a Transformer layer is employed to inject text-based semantic prior into an object query, with the entire sentence-level feature 𝐓 \mathbf{T} serving as the key and value. Then, a mask-derived spatial prior is obtained from 𝐌 \mathbf{M} through a mask-to-box strategy and adaptively incorporated into the query and its position embedding via a learnable gate. This design enables REC to benefit from the spatial knowledge acquired through dense segmentation, while the localization objective in turn provides geometric constraints for rectifying the result of RES.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出DeCo,它遵循一个双联学习模式. 如图1(d)所示,DeCo首先引入了一个任务意识语义解析模块,将共享的 V\mathcal{V} 引导到本地化和分化导向的多尺度特性, V l o c\mathcal{V}^{loc} 和 V s e g\mathcal{V}^{seg}, 在显著的字位特性 t s\mathb{t}_{s} 的指导下. 它保证两个目标从各自的特征利益中学习不同的表述,同时保持共享多尺度编码的效率。 随后,DeCo进一步利用混合前置耦合模块,利用两个任务的互补信息. 具体地说,一个变形器层用于在对象查询前注入基于文本的语义,整个句位功能T\mathbf{T}作为键和值. 然后,从M\mathbf{M}中通过一个口罩对箱策略获得一个面具衍生的空间前缀,并适应性地通过一个可学习的门融入查询及其位置嵌入. 这种设计使REC能够受益于通过密集分化获得的空间知识,而本地化目标则为纠正RES的结果提供了几何限制。

blocks.en: 3.2 Task-aware Semantic Decoupling
blocks.zh: 3.2 意识到任务的语义解析

blocks.en: The widely adopted shared-representation paradigm overlooks the distinctiveness of REC and RES. To capture discriminative features for each objective, we propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD), which decouples 𝒱 \mathcal{V} via salient word-level modulation and lightweight task-specific experts.

blocks.en: We exploit the two complementary signals from cross-attention to construct localization- and segmentation-oriented representations. Both experts adopt the same lightweight architecture, consisting of two 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional layers interleaved with GELU activation and LayerNorm. For localization, the word-conditioned global response 𝐑 l \mathbf{R}_{l} is broadcastly connected with the original visual tokens, enhancing semantic cues that facilitate object-level correspondence: 𝐕 l l ​ o ​ c = ℰ l l ​ o ​ c ​ ( reshape ⁡ ( 𝐗 l + 𝐑 l ) ) , \mathbf{V}^{loc}_{l}=\mathcal{E}^{loc}_{l}\big(\operatorname{reshape}(\mathbf{X}_{l}+\mathbf{R}_{l})\big), (4) where ℰ l l ​ o ​ c \mathcal{E}^{loc}_{l} denotes the REC-specific expert network and reshape ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{reshape}(\cdot) restores the spatial dimensions of the visual tokens to h l × w l h_{l}\times w_{l} . For segmentation, we instead use the spatial relevance distribution 𝐃 l \mathbf{D}_{l} to reweight the shared visual tokens, highlighting target-relevant regions while preserving their fine-grained spatial structure, which can be mathematically formulated as follows: 𝐕 l s ​ e ​ g = ℰ l s ​ e ​ g ​ ( reshape ⁡ ( 𝐗 l ⊙ 𝐃 l ⊤ ) ) , \mathbf{V}^{seg}_{l}=\mathcal{E}^{seg}_{l}\big(\operatorname{reshape}(\mathbf{X}_{l}\odot\mathbf{D}_{l}^{\top})\big), (5) where ⊙ \odot represents element-wise multiplication and ℰ l s ​ e ​ g \mathcal{E}^{seg}_{l} is the RES-specific expert network. This asymmetric design allows localization to incorporate explicit word-aware semantic responses while segmentation focuses on spatially relevant visual regions. The resulting task-specific multi-scale representations 𝒱 l ​ o ​ c ∈ { 𝐕 l l ​ o ​ c } l = 1 L \mathcal{V}^{loc}\in\{\mathbf{V}_{l}^{loc}\}_{l=1}^{L} and 𝒱 s ​ e ​ g ∈ { 𝐕 l s ​ e ​ g } l = 1 L \mathcal{V}^{seg}\in\{\mathbf{V}_{l}^{seg}\}_{l=1}^{L} are subsequently delivered to their respective branches, thereby alleviating the mutual competition arising from shared representations and allowing each task to preserve its preferred visual cues.

blocks.en: 3.3 Hybrid Prior Coupling
blocks.zh: 3.3 先前混合

blocks.en: While TSD ensures task-oriented features, localization and segmentation remain inherently complementary. In particular, dense pixel supervision enables RES to produce a reliable object proposal earlier in training than sparse box supervision used in REC. To exploit this property, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior and mask-derived spatial prior into the localization query, thereby establishing a collaborative coupling mechanism.
blocks.zh: 虽然信息技术事务司确保以任务为导向的特点,但本地化和分散化仍然具有内在的互补性。 特别是,密集的像素监督使RES能够在培训中比REC使用的零散箱监督更早提出可靠的对象建议. 为了利用这个属性,我们引入了HPC-Prior Coupling(HPC),将句位语义在本地化查询前和口罩衍生的空间融合到本地化查询中,从而建立了协作的耦合机制.

blocks.en: Given the sentence-level feature 𝐓 \mathbf{T} , we initially project it into the query embedding space via a linear layer 𝐖 T ∈ ℝ d × c \mathbf{W}_{\rm T}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times c} . A Transformer layer is then employed to incorporate the textual semantic information into the randomly initialized object query 𝐪 ∈ ℝ 1 × c \mathbf{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times c} . Specifically, the object query first interacts with itself through self-attention and subsequently aggregates global linguistic contexts via cross-attention, followed by a feed-forward network (FFN): 𝐪 ~ = FFN ⁡ ( CrossAttn ⁡ ( SelfAttn ⁡ ( 𝐪 + 𝐩 ) + 𝐩 , 𝐓𝐖 T , 𝐓𝐖 T ) ) , \tilde{\mathbf{q}}=\operatorname{FFN}\Big(\operatorname{CrossAttn}\big(\operatorname{SelfAttn}(\mathbf{q}+\mathbf{p})+\mathbf{p},\mathbf{T}\mathbf{W}_{\rm T},\mathbf{T}\mathbf{W}_{\rm T}\big)\Big), (6) where 𝐩 ∈ ℝ 1 × c \mathbf{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times c} denotes the position embedding of 𝐪 \mathbf{q} . Unlike TSD, which employs the salient word-level feature to provide a compact discriminative cue for feature decoupling, HPC utilizes the entire sentence-level feature to capture holistic linguistic semantics for object localization, explicitly grounding the initial query in the semantic space of the referring expression.

blocks.en:
Pixel-level segmentation inherently provides informative object geometry that can complement the semantic query. To further transfer this prior knowledge, we convert the predicted binary mask 𝐌 \mathbf{M} into a normalized bounding box 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b \mathbf{B}_{m2b} through a mask-to-box strategy. Given coordinate grids x i ​ j x_{ij} and y i ​ j y_{ij} , we apply each grid with an extremal constant according to the mask value and aggregate the foreground extremes via global min and max reductions as follows: x min = min i , j ⁡ ( 𝐌 i ​ j ​ x i ​ j + ( 1 − 𝐌 i ​ j ) ​ w ) , x max = max i , j ⁡ ( 𝐌 i ​ j ​ x i ​ j − ( 1 − 𝐌 i ​ j ) ) , y min = min i , j ⁡ ( 𝐌 i ​ j ​ y i ​ j + ( 1 − 𝐌 i ​ j ) ​ h ) , y max = max i , j ⁡ ( 𝐌 i ​ j ​ y i ​ j − ( 1 − 𝐌 i ​ j ) ) , \begin{aligned} x_{\min}&=\min_{i,j}\big(\mathbf{M}_{ij}x_{ij}+(1-\mathbf{M}_{ij})w\big),\\
x_{\max}&=\max_{i,j}\big(\mathbf{M}_{ij}x_{ij}-(1-\mathbf{M}_{ij})\big),\end{aligned}\qquad\begin{aligned} y_{\min}&=\min_{i,j}\big(\mathbf{M}_{ij}y_{ij}+(1-\mathbf{M}_{ij})h\big),\\
y_{\max}&=\max_{i,j}\big(\mathbf{M}_{ij}y_{ij}-(1-\mathbf{M}_{ij})\big),\end{aligned} (7) 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b = [ ( x min + x max ) / 2 ​ w , ( y min + y max ) / 2 ​ h , ( x max − x min ) / w , ( y max − y min ) / h ] , \mathbf{B}_{m2b}=\big[(x_{\min}+x_{\max})/2w,\ (y_{\min}+y_{\max})/2h,\ (x_{\max}-x_{\min})/w,\ (y_{\max}-y_{\min})/h\big], (8) which is further mapped into the query and position embedding spaces, respectively: 𝐪 m ​ 2 ​ b = 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b ​ 𝐖 m ​ 2 ​ b q , 𝐩 m ​ 2 ​ b = 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b ​ 𝐖 m ​ 2 ​ b p , \mathbf{q}_{m2b}=\mathbf{B}_{m2b}\mathbf{W}_{m2b}^{q},\qquad\mathbf{p}_{m2b}=\mathbf{B}_{m2b}\mathbf{W}_{m2b}^{p}, (9) where 𝐖 m ​ 2 ​ b q , 𝐖 m ​ 2 ​ b p ∈ ℝ 4 × c \mathbf{W}_{m2b}^{q},\mathbf{W}_{m2b}^{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{4\times c} are two projection matrices. To adaptively balance the contributions of semantic and spatial information, we design a lightweight gating function conditioned on both the semantic-enriched query and the mask-derived bounding box: γ = σ ⁡ ( MLP ⁡ ( Concat ⁡ ( 𝐪 ~ ; 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b ) ) ) , \gamma=\sigma\Big(\operatorname{MLP}\big(\operatorname{Concat}(\tilde{\mathbf{q}};\mathbf{B}_{m2b})\big)\Big), (10) where Concat ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) \operatorname{Concat}(\cdot\,;\cdot) , MLP ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{MLP}(\cdot) , and σ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \sigma(\cdot) represent concatenation, two linear layers separated by a GELU activation, and the sigmoid function, respectively. The gate value γ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \gamma\in(0,1) is then utilized to get the final hybrid prior query and its position embedding as follows: 𝐪 ^ = γ ​ 𝐪 ~ + ( 1 − γ ) ​ 𝐪 m ​ 2 ​ b , 𝐩 ^ = γ ​ 𝐩 + ( 1 − γ ) ​ 𝐩 m ​ 2 ​ b . \hat{\mathbf{q}}=\gamma\hskip 0.5pt\tilde{\mathbf{q}}+(1-\gamma)\ \mathbf{q}_{m2b},\qquad\hat{\mathbf{p}}=\gamma\hskip 0.5pt\mathbf{p}+(1-\gamma)\mathbf{p}_{m2b}. (11) In this way, HPC evolves the randomly initialized object query into a strong context-geometric anchor that accelerates the convergence of the localization branch, while the resulting detection loss in turn provides bounding constraints that further refine the segmentation mask.
3.4 Training Objectives
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训目标

blocks.en:
Given the hybrid prior query 𝐪 ^ \hat{\mathbf{q}} , its position embedding 𝐩 ^ \hat{\mathbf{p}} , and REC-specific features 𝒱 l ​ o ​ c \mathcal{V}^{loc} , we first employ Deformable DETR ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) to produce the output query 𝐪 o \mathbf{q}_{\rm o} . Subsequently, a box FFN regresses 𝐪 o \mathbf{q}_{\rm o} into the predicted box 𝐁 \mathbf{B} , while a mask FFN projects 𝐪 o \mathbf{q}_{\rm o} into a mask embedding, which is multiplied with the high-resolution segmentation feature 𝐕 1 s ​ e ​ g \mathbf{V}_{1}^{seg} to obtain the corresponding instance mask 𝐌 i ​ n ​ s \mathbf{M}_{ins} . In parallel, RES-specific features 𝒱 s ​ e ​ g \mathcal{V}^{seg} are fed into UNet ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) to get the predicted mask 𝐌 \mathbf{M} . The overall prediction process can be formulated as: 𝐪 o = DETR ⁡ ( 𝐪 ^ , 𝐩 ^ , 𝒱 l ​ o ​ c ) , 𝐁 = FFN b ⁡ ( 𝐪 o ) , 𝐌 i ​ n ​ s = FFN m ⁡ ( 𝐪 o ) ⊗ 𝐕 1 s ​ e ​ g , 𝐌 = UNet ⁡ ( 𝒱 s ​ e ​ g ) \mathbf{q}_{\rm o}=\operatorname{DETR}(\hat{\mathbf{q}},~\hat{\mathbf{p}},~\mathcal{V}^{loc}),~\mathbf{B}=\operatorname{FFN}_{b}(\mathbf{q}_{\rm o}),~\mathbf{M}_{ins}=\operatorname{FFN}_{m}(\mathbf{q}_{\rm o})\otimes\mathbf{V}_{1}^{seg},~\mathbf{M}=\operatorname{UNet}(\mathcal{V}^{seg}) (12) where ⊗ \otimes denotes Einstein multiplication. For box regression, we adopt L1 loss and generalized IoU loss, while a combination of binary cross-entropy and Dice losses is used for mask prediction: ℒ d ​ e ​ t = ℒ l ​ 1 ​ ( 𝐁 , 𝐁 ∗ ) + ℒ g ​ i ​ o ​ u ​ ( 𝐁 , 𝐁 ∗ ) , ℒ s ​ e ​ g = ℒ b ​ c ​ e ​ ( 𝐌 , 𝐌 ∗ ) + ℒ d ​ i ​ c ​ e ​ ( 𝐌 , 𝐌 ∗ ) , ℒ i ​ n ​ s = ℒ b ​ c ​ e ​ ( 𝐌 i ​ n ​ s , 𝐌 ∗ ) + ℒ d ​ i ​ c ​ e ​ ( 𝐌 i ​ n ​ s , 𝐌 ∗ ) , ℒ m ​ 2 ​ b = ℒ l ​ 1 ​ ( 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b , 𝐁 ∗ ) + ℒ g ​ i ​ o ​ u ​ ( 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b , 𝐁 ∗ ) , \begin{aligned} \mathcal{L}_{det}&=\mathcal{L}_{l1}(\mathbf{B},\mathbf{B}^{*})+\mathcal{L}_{giou}(\mathbf{B},\mathbf{B}^{*}),\\
\mathcal{L}_{seg}&=\mathcal{L}_{bce}(\mathbf{M},\mathbf{M}^{*})+\mathcal{L}_{dice}(\mathbf{M},\mathbf{M}^{*}),\end{aligned}\quad\begin{aligned} \mathcal{L}_{ins}&=\mathcal{L}_{bce}(\mathbf{M}_{ins},\mathbf{M}^{*})+\mathcal{L}_{dice}(\mathbf{M}_{ins},\mathbf{M}^{*}),\\
\mathcal{L}_{m2b}&=\mathcal{L}_{l1}(\mathbf{B}_{m2b},\mathbf{B}^{*})+\mathcal{L}_{giou}(\mathbf{B}_{m2b},\mathbf{B}^{*}),\end{aligned} (13) where 𝐁 ∗ \mathbf{B}^{*} and 𝐌 ∗ \mathbf{M}^{*} are the ground-truth bounding box and segmentation mask. Finally, the total training objective is defined as a simple weighted sum of the four loss functions with same weights: ℒ t ​ o ​ t ​ a ​ l = ℒ d ​ e ​ t + ℒ i ​ n ​ s + ℒ s ​ e ​ g + ℒ m ​ 2 ​ b . \mathcal{L}_{total}=\mathcal{L}_{det}+\mathcal{L}_{ins}+\mathcal{L}_{seg}+\mathcal{L}_{m2b}. (14) During inference, only 𝐁 \mathbf{B} and 𝐌 \mathbf{M} are retained as the final REC and RES predictions. The auxiliary outputs 𝐌 i ​ n ​ s \mathbf{M}_{ins} and 𝐁 m ​ 2 ​ b \mathbf{B}_{m2b} are involved in the forward process but are discarded from the final outputs, requiring no additional post-processing.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets & Metrics. We conduct extensive experiments on ten benchmarks covering both natural and remote sensing images. For natural images, we evaluate DeCo on RefCOCO ( Yu et al., 2016 ) , RefCOCO+ ( Yu et al., 2016 ) , and G-Ref ( Nagaraja et al., 2016 ; Mao et al., 2016 ) for both REC and RES, while ReferIt ( Kazemzadeh et al., 2014 ) and Flickr ( Plummer et al., 2015 ) for REC. To further examine cross-domain generalization, we additionally evaluate DeCo on five remote sensing benchmarks, including DIOR-RSVG ( Zhan et al., 2023 ) , SARVG1.0 ( Li et al., 2025 ) , RRSIS-D ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , RIS-LAD ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , and RefDIOR ( Lu et al., 2025 ) . Following previous works ( Xiao et al., 2024b ; Dai et al., 2025a ) , we report P@.5 for REC, while oIoU and mIoU are for RES. In the ablation studies, we additionally report P@.5:.95 for a more precise REC evaluation. More descriptions about datasets and metrics are provided in Appendix B.1 and B.2 .
blocks.zh: 数据集与计量. 我们对自然和遥感图像的10个基准进行了广泛的试验。 对于自然图像,我们在RefCOCO(Yu等人,2016年),RefCO+(Yu等人,2016年)和G-Ref(Nagaraja等人,2016年;Mao等人,2016年)上评价DECo,而REC和RES则在ReferenceIt(Kazemzadeh等人,2014年)和Flickr(Plummer等人,2015年)上评价DeCo。 为了进一步审查跨域概况,我们还根据五个遥感基准对DECo进行了评价,包括DOOR-RSVG(Zhan等人,2023年),SARVG1.0(Li等人,2025年),RRSIS-D(Liu等人,2024年b),RIS-LAD(Ye等人,2026年)和RefDIOR(Lu等人,2025年)。 继先前的作品(萧等人,2024年b;戴等人,2025年a)之后,我们向REC报告P@5,而OIOU和MIOU则向RES报告。 在减税研究中,我们又报告P@5:95,以便进行更准确的区域经济共同体评价。 附录B.1和B.2进一步说明了数据集和衡量标准。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We adopt two model scales, BEiT3-B and BEiT3-L ( Wang et al., 2023b ) , as frozen multimodal encoders and introduce LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for parameter-efficient adaptation. For most experiments, we train DeCo using the Adam optimizer for 35 35 epochs, with the learning rate reduced by a factor of 10 10 at the 28 28 -th epoch. The input image is resized to 448 × 448 448\times 448 , and the maximum expression length is limited to 20 20 tokens. The initial learning rate is set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , with the batch size of 32 32 . More implementation details are provided in Appendix B.3 .
blocks.zh: 执行详情。 我们采用BeiT3-B和BeiT3-L两个模型(Wang等人,2023b)作为冷冻的多式联运编码器,并将LORA(Hu等人,2022年)用于参数效率调整。 对于大多数实验,我们使用亚当优化器对35个35个纪元进行DeCo的训练,在28个28个纪元时,学习率降低了10倍. 输入图像的大小调整为448×448 448\times 448,最大表达长度限于20个令牌. 初始学习率设定为1×10−4 1\times 10×4},批量规模为3232 . 附录B.3提供了更多的执行细节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Referring Expression Comprehension. As evaluated in Table 1 and Table 3 , DeCo consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to all MLLM-based and task-specific methods across both standard and mixed settings. With frozen BEiT3-B/L ( Wang et al., 2023b ) backbones, DeCo sets top results on all eight splits under the mixed setting (90.5%/93.1% average P@.5) and delivers gains of up to 3.9%, 3.3%, and 0.8% on G-Ref (val-g), ReferIt, and Flickr, respectively. These results validate that decoupling task-preferred representations and coupling complementary priors effectively eliminates task interference while generalizing across diverse domains.
blocks.zh: 参考表达理解。 如表1和表3所评价的,DeCo在标准环境和混合环境中,与所有基于MLLM和针对具体任务的方法相比,始终实现了最先进的性能。 由于BeiT3-B/L(王等人,2023年b)骨干被冻结,DeCo在混合设置下为所有8个拆分设定最高结果(平均为90.5%/93.1%P@5),在G-Ref(val-g)、ReferenceIt和Flickr上分别实现3.9%、3.3%和0.8%的收益。 这些结果证明,将任务偏好表述脱钩,将互补的前科结合在一起,有效地消除了任务干扰,同时将任务范围扩大到不同领域。

blocks.en: Referring Expression Segmentation. As shown in Table 2 and Table 4 , DeCo sets new RES records across all benchmarks under the standard setting. With BEiT3-B/L, DeCo outperforms OneRef by 2.1%/2.9% average oIoU while keeping backbones frozen. Compared with MLLM-based methods, DeCo surpasses Text4Seg++-14B by 3.1% average oIoU and the strongest competitor STAMP-7B on all eight splits. Furthermore, DeCo exceeds DETRIS and WIMFRIS by significant margins of 13.4% oIoU and 9.8% mIoU on G-Ref (val-g), highlighting robust generalization to complex expressions. More RES results with mIoU and other remote sensing experiments are listed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 代言表达分裂. 如表2和表4所示,DeCo在标准设定下为所有基准设置新的RES记录。 随着BEiT3-B/L,DeCo的成绩超过 1参考文献2.1%/2.9%的平均有机铀,同时将骨干冻结。 与基于MLLM的方法相比,DeCo超越了Text4Seg++-14B,以3.1%的平均oIoU和所有8个拆分上最强的竞争对手STAMP-7B. 此外,DeCo在G-Ref(val-g)上大大超过DERIS和WMFRIS的13.4%ooU和9.8%mIoU,突出显示对复杂表达的强烈概括。 附录C列出了与mIoU和其他遥感实验有关的更多RES成果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented DeCo, an efficient decouple-to-couple learning framework for unified referring expression comprehension and segmentation. By first decoupling shared visual representations into task-specific features and then coupling complementary semantic and spatial priors, DeCo enables each task to exploit its preferred visual cues while benefiting from cross-task knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods across multiple referring expression benchmarks and settings, with only lightweight adaptation of the pretrained backbone. Our results suggest that explicitly managing the tension between task-specificity and task complementarity provides an effective and efficient paradigm for multi-task visual grounding.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了DeCo, 一个有效的双联学习框架, 用于统一引用表达理解和分割。 通过首先将共享的视觉表现与任务特定特征脱钩,然后将互补的语义学和空间学前科结合,DeCo使每个任务在受益于交叉任务知识的同时,能够利用其偏好的视觉提示. 广泛的实验表明,在多种参考表达基准和设置中,与现有方法相比,不断改进,只有经过预先训练的主干网的轻量级改造。 我们的结果表明,明确处理具体任务与任务互补之间的紧张关系,为多任务可视化打下基础提供了有效和高效的模式。

blocks.en: B.1.1 Natural Image Benchmarks
blocks.zh: B.1.1 自然图像基准

blocks.en: We first evaluate DeCo on five widely used natural image benchmarks: RefCOCO ( Yu et al., 2016 ) is derived from MSCOCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and contains relatively concise referring expressions for identifying objects in diverse everyday scenes. RefCOCO+ ( Yu et al., 2016 ) follows the same image source but removes location-based expressions, placing greater emphasis on appearance-related attributes and therefore requiring finer-grained correspondence. G-Ref ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) provides substantially longer and more descriptive expressions, with an average of 8.4 words per expression, making it a challenging benchmark for multi-task visual grounding. It provides two different partitions, UMD ( Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) and Google ( Mao et al., 2016 ) , with the former adopted as the main training and evaluation protocol in our experiments. ReferIt ( Kazemzadeh et al., 2014 ) contains referring expressions collected for objects and regions in natural images and provides a large test set for evaluating generalization beyond MSCOCO-based benchmarks. Flickr ( Plummer et al., 2015 ) constructs large-scale image-phrase pairs with relatively short descriptions, providing an additional benchmark for evaluating REC in diverse natural scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们首先根据五种广泛使用的自然图像基准评价DeCo: RefCOCO(Yu等人,2016年)来源于MSCOCO(Lin等人,2014年),并包含相对简洁的参考表达,用于识别不同日常场景中的物体. RefCOCO+(Yu等人,2016年)遵循相同的图像源,但删除了基于位置的表达方式,更加强调与外观相关的属性,因此需要更精细的纹理通信. G-Ref (Mao et al., 2016; Nagaraja et al., 2016 )提供了大量更长和更多的描述性表达方式,每个表达方式平均为8.4个字,使其成为多任务视觉地面的具有挑战性的基准. 它提供了两个不同的分区,UMD(Nagaraja等人,2016年)和Google(Mao等人,2016年),前者被采纳为我们实验中的主要培训和评价协议. ReferenceIt(Kazemzadeh等人,2014年)载有自然图像中为物体和区域收集的参考表达式,并为评价超出基于MSCO的基准的通用性提供了一套大型测试。 Flickr (Plummer 等人,2015年) 搭建了规模较大的图像词组,描述相对较短,为在多样的自然场景中评价REC提供了额外的基准.

blocks.en: Following previous works ( Xiao et al., 2024b ; Dai et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , we conduct experiments on both the Standard and Mixed settings. In the standard setting, each dataset is trained and evaluated independently using its corresponding splits. In the mixed setting, we combine the training sets of RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and the UMD partition of G-Ref to construct a unified training set, while keeping their original validation and test splits separate for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 之后的作品(萧等人, 2024b; Dai等人, 2025b;Chen等人, 2026a),我们进行标准与混合设置的实验. 在标准设置中,每个数据集都使用其相应的拆分来独立训练和评价. 在混合设置中,我们结合了RefCOCO,RefCOCO+的训练集和G-Ref的UMD分区来构建一个统一的训练集,同时保持原有的验证和测试分拆进行评价.

blocks.en: B.1.2 Remote Sensing Image Benchmarks
blocks.zh: B.1.2 遥感图像基准

blocks.en: To further examine the generalization of DeCo beyond natural images, we consider five remote sensing benchmarks, including optical, SAR, and UAV imagery. DIOR-RSVG ( Zhan et al., 2023 ) is an optical visual grounding benchmark, where referring expressions are used to identify specific objects in aerial scenes. Compared with natural images, the large image scale, dense object distributions, and substantial appearance variations introduce additional challenges for localization. SARVG1.0 ( Li et al., 2025 ) focuses on visual grounding in SAR imagery. In contrast to optical imagery, SAR observations exhibit distinct scattering characteristics and substantially different visual patterns, providing a challenging testbed for evaluating the robustness of DeCo under various imaging modalities. RRSIS-D ( Liu et al., 2024b ) is an optical referring image segmentation benchmark that associates textual description with pixel-level object masks. It therefore evaluates whether language-guided understanding can be translated from object-level localization to fine-grained spatial segmentation in aerial scenes. RIS-LAD ( Ye et al., 2026 ) further considers UAV imagery and contains substantially longer referring expressions, with an average length of 19.6 words. Its fine-grained descriptions and aerial perspectives provide a more challenging setting for evaluating tiny object segmentation. RefDIOR ( Lu et al., 2025 ) provides a unified benchmark covering both object localization and pixel-level segmentation in optical remote sensing imagery. We use it to evaluate the unified referring remote sensing comprehension and segmentation capability of DeCo, thereby extending the joint REC and RES formulation to remote sensing scenarios. All the above remote sensing image benchmarks follow the standard setting for training, validation, and testing.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步审查DeCo超越自然图像的范围,我们考虑了五项遥感基准,包括光学、合成孔径雷达和无人驾驶航空器图像。 DIOR-RSVG(Zhan等人,2023年)是一个光学视觉地面基准,在空中场景中,参考表达法用于识别特定物体. 与自然图像相比,大图像尺度,密集的物体分布,以及巨大的外观变化,为本地化带来了额外的挑战. SARVG1.0(Li等人,2025年)侧重于在SAR图像中的视觉地面. 与光学图像相反,合成孔径雷达观测显示出明显的散射特征和显著不同的视觉模式,为评价DeCo在各种成像模式下的稳健性提供了一个具有挑战性的试验台。 RRSIS-D(Liu等人,2024b)是一个光学参考图像分解基准,将文字描述与像素级物体口罩联系起来. 因此,它评价语言引导的理解是否能够从物体级局部化转化为空中场景中的细纹空间分区. RIS-LAD(Ye等人,2026年)进一步考虑了无人驾驶航空器图像,并含有相当长的参考表达,平均长度为19.6字. 其精细的描述和空中视角为评价小物体的分裂提供了更具挑战性的环境。 RefDIOR(Lu等人,2025年)提供了一个统一的基准,涵盖光学遥感图像中的物体定位和像素级分化。 我们利用它来评价DeCo统一使用遥感理解和分解能力,从而将REC和RES联合配制扩展到遥感情景。 上述所有遥感图像基准都遵循培训、验证和测试的标准设定。

blocks.en: In the main experiments, we evaluate DeCo using commonly used metrics for REC, RES, and their corresponding remote sensing variants, RSVG and RRSIS. For REC, we adopt Precision@IoU threshold of 0.5 ( P@.5 ), which measures the percentage of predictions whose IoU with the ground-truth box exceeds 0.5. Specifically, given the i i -th predicted bounding box 𝐁 i \mathbf{B}_{i} and its corresponding ground-truth box 𝐁 i ∗ \mathbf{B}_{i}^{*} , P@.5 can be calculated as follows: IoU ( 𝐁 i , 𝐁 i ∗ ) = | 𝐁 i ∩ 𝐁 i ∗ | | 𝐁 i ∪ 𝐁 i ∗ | , P @.5 = 1 N ∑ i = 1 N 𝕀 [ IoU ( 𝐁 i , 𝐁 i ∗ ) ≥ 0.5 ] , \operatorname{IoU}(\mathbf{B}_{i},\mathbf{B}_{i}^{*})=\frac{|\mathbf{B}_{i}\cap\mathbf{B}_{i}^{*}|}{|\mathbf{B}_{i}\cup\mathbf{B}_{i}^{*}|},\qquad{\rm P\text{@.5}}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbb{I}\big[\operatorname{IoU}(\mathbf{B}_{i},\mathbf{B}_{i}^{*})\geq\text{0.5}\big], (19) where N N denotes the number of referring expressions and 𝕀 ⁡ [ ⋅ ] \mathbb{I}[\cdot] is the indicator function. For RES, we report overall IoU ( oIoU ) and mean IoU ( mIoU ). Given the predicted mask 𝐌 i \mathbf{M}_{i} and the ground-truth mask 𝐌 i ∗ \mathbf{M}_{i}^{*} , oIoU aggregates the intersection and union across all samples, while mIoU averages the per-sample IoU, which can be formulated as follows: oIoU = ∑ i = 1 N | 𝐌 i ∩ 𝐌 i ∗ | ∑ i = 1 N | 𝐌 i ∪ 𝐌 i ∗ | , mIoU = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N | 𝐌 i ∩ 𝐌 i ∗ | | 𝐌 i ∪ 𝐌 i ∗ | . \operatorname{oIoU}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N}|\mathbf{M}_{i}\cap\mathbf{M}_{i}^{*}|}{\sum_{i=1}^{N}|\mathbf{M}_{i}\cup\mathbf{M}_{i}^{*}|},\qquad\operatorname{mIoU}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\frac{|\mathbf{M}_{i}\cap\mathbf{M}_{i}^{*}|}{|\mathbf{M}_{i}\cup\mathbf{M}_{i}^{*}|}. blocks.en: B.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: B.3 执行细节

blocks.en: We instantiate DeCo with two model scales, termed DeCo-B and DeCo-L , using frozen BEiT3-B/L ( Wang et al., 2023b ) with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adaptation as the multimodal encoders, respectively. For localization, we adopt a decoder-only Deformable DETR ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) consisting of four Transformer decoder layers, with a feature dimension of 256 256 and an FFN hidden dimension of 1,024 1,024 . For segmentation, we employ a lightweight UNet ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) with an input feature dimension of 256 256 and a hidden embedding dimension of 32 32 . For datasets without mask annotations, including ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, and SARVG1.0, we use box-filled binary masks derived from the ground-truth bounding boxes as pseudo-mask supervision. We use Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) as the optimizer and MultiStepLR as the learning rate scheduler for all benchmarks. The dataset-specific training configurations are summarized in Table 10 . The maximum text length is set to 20 20 tokens for all benchmarks except RIS-LAD, for which we use 40 40 tokens due to its substantially longer referring expressions. All experiments are conducted on eight NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs. Different batch sizes and learning rates are adopted for DeCo-B and DeCo-L according to their model scales and the input resolutions of various benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个模型天平(DeCo-B和DeCo-L)对DeCo进行即时分析,分别使用冷冻的BeiT3-B/L(Wang等人,2023年b)和LORA(Hu等人,2022年b)作为多式联运编码器。 对于本地化,我们采用一个只有解码器的变形DETR(Zhu等人,2021年),由四个变形器解码器层组成,特征维度为256256,FFN隐藏维度为1,0241,024. 在分化方面,我们使用一个轻量级UNet(Ronneberger等人,2015年),输入特征维度为256 256,隐藏嵌入维度为32 32。 对于没有蒙面说明的数据集,包括ReferenceIt,Flickr,DIOR-RSVG,以及SARVG1.0,我们使用从地面-真实边框中提取的箱装二进制口罩作为假面具监督. 我们使用亚当(Kingma and Ba,2015年)作为优化器和MultiStepLR作为所有基准的学习速率调度器. 表10汇总了数据集特定培训配置。 除RIS-LAD外,所有基准的最大文本长度被设定为20个令牌,我们为此使用40个令牌,因为其参考时间大大延长。 所有实验均在8台NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上进行. DeCo-B和DeCo-L根据其模型尺度和各种基准的输入分辨率采用不同的批量大小和学习率。

blocks.en: C.2 Generalization to Remote Sensing Scenarios
blocks.zh: C.2 遥感设想概况

blocks.en: Beyond the standard natural image benchmarks, we further investigate the generalization of DeCo to diverse remote sensing scenarios. Compared with natural images, remote sensing imagery exhibits substantial domain shifts caused by aerial viewpoints, large-scale variations, dense object distributions, and modality-specific visual characteristics, posing additional challenges to multi-task visual grounding. In this domain, REC and RES are extended to remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) ( Sun et al., 2022 ) and referring remote sensing image segmentation (RRSIS) ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , respectively. To provide a comprehensive evaluation, we consider multiple benchmarks spanning optical, SAR, and UAV imagery, enabling us to assess whether the proposed method remains effective under substantially different visual distributions and imaging modalities.
blocks.zh: 在标准自然图像基准之外,我们进一步调查DeCo对多种遥感情景的概括。 与自然图像相比,遥感图像显示出由于空中视线、大规模变异、物体分布稠密以及模式特有的视觉特征而造成的重大域位变化,对多任务视觉地面构成了额外的挑战。 在这一领域,REC和RES被扩展至遥感视觉地面(RSVG)(Sun等人,2022年),并分别提及遥感图像分区(RRSIS)(袁等人,2024年)。 为了提供全面评价,我们考虑了涵盖光学、合成孔径雷达和无人驾驶航空器图像的多种基准,使我们能够评估拟议方法在显著不同的视觉分布和成像模式下是否仍然有效。

blocks.en: Main results for RSVG on DIOR-RSVG. Table 14 reports the results on the DIOR-RSVG test set. DeCo-B already achieves competitive performance, obtaining 85.2% P@.5 and 76.0% mIoU, which are on par with the strongest existing methods. Scaling to DeCo-L further yields consistent improvements across all evaluation metrics. Specifically, DeCo-L achieves 86.9%, 84.3%, 79.0%, 69.2%, and 47.6% under P@.5–P@.9, respectively, while reaching 86.2% oIoU and 78.6% mIoU. Compared with the recent advanced method, VisproVG ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , DeCo-L improves P@.5, P@.7, P@.9, oIoU, and mIoU by 1.7%, 0.8%, 0.7%, 1.5%, and 2.6%, respectively. The consistent gains across increasingly strict IoU thresholds indicate that DeCo not only identifies the referred remote sensing objects reliably but also produces more precise localization.
blocks.zh: RSVG关于DOOR-RSVG的主要结果. 表14报告了DIOR-RSVG测试结果。 DeCo-B已经实现了竞争性能,获得了85.2%的P@.5和76.0%的mIoU,与现有最强方法相当. 扩大至DeCo-L,使所有评价指标都得到持续改进。 具体来说,DeCo-L在P@5-P@9下分别实现86.9%,84.3%,79.0%,69.2%和47.6%,同时达到86.2%的OIOU和78.6%的mIOU. 与近期的先进方法相比,VisproVG(Zhang等人,2026b),DeCo-L分别将P@5,P@7,P@9,OIOU和mIOU分别提高了1.7%,0.8%,0.7%,1.5%和2.6%. 越来越严格的IoU阈值的一致收益表明,DeCo不仅可靠地识别了上述遥感物体,而且还产生了更精确的本地化。

blocks.en: Main results for RSVG on SARVG1.0. Table 14 lists the results on the SARVG1.0 test set, which further examines the generalization of DeCo from optical imagery to SAR modality. Despite the distinct scattering characteristics and visual appearance of SAR, both DeCo-B and DeCo-L achieve strong performance across all evaluation metrics. DeCo-B reaches 89.6% P@.5 and 83.8% mIoU, already surpassing the previous best method, TACMT ( Li et al., 2025 ) , on all reported precision thresholds. DeCo-L further improves the performance to 91.2% P@.5 and 86.3% mIoU. The advantage becomes more evident under stricter localization criteria. At P@.9, DeCo-B and DeCo-L achieve 73.5% and 75.1%, outperforming TACMT by 5.2% and 6.8%, respectively. These consistent gains across various IoU thresholds demonstrate that DeCo can effectively transfer its language-guided localization capability to SAR imagery while maintaining high localization precision.
blocks.zh: RSVG关于SAVG1.0的主要结果. 表14列出了SARVG1.0测试集的结果,该测试集进一步审查了DeCo从光学图像到SAR模式的一般化. 尽管搜索和救援系统具有明显的分散特征和视觉外观,但DeCo-B和DeCo-L在所有评价指标上都取得了良好的业绩。 DeCo-B在所有报告的精确阈值上达到89.6%的P@.5和83.8%的mIoU,已经超过了以往的最佳方法TACMT(Li等人,2025年)。 DeCo-L将性能进一步提高到91.2% P@.5和86.3% mIoU. 根据更严格的本地化标准,这一优势变得更加明显。 在P@9中,DeCo-B和DeCo-L分别达到73.5%和75.1%,分别比TACMT高5.2%和6.8%。 这些跨越各种IoU阈值的一致收益表明,DeCo能够有效地将其语言引导本地化能力转移到合成孔径雷达图像,同时保持高本地化精度.

blocks.en: Main results for RSVG on RefDIOR. Table 14 summarizes the localization results on the RefDIOR test set. RefDIOR is designed for multi-task visual grounding in remote sensing scenes, making it a more comprehensive benchmark for evaluating our DeCo. DeCo-B achieves 83.1% P@.5 and 75.0% mIoU, surpassing the previous best method, CCFormer ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , across all reported metrics. DeCo-L further improves the results to 85.3% P@.5 and 77.0% mIoU. The superiority of DeCo remains consistent under stricter IoU thresholds. Compared with CCFormer, DeCo-L improves P@.5, P@.7, and P@.9 by 2.9%, 3.8%, and 4.2%, respectively, while gaining 1.8% in oIoU and 2.9% in mIoU. These results indicate that the benefits of modeling task-specificity and cross-task complementarity also extend to unified multi-task learning in remote sensing scenarios.
blocks.zh: 关于RefDIOR的RSVG的主要结果. 表14概述了RefDIOR测试集的本地化结果。 RefDIOR是为在遥感场景中进行多任务可视化定位而设计的,使其成为评估我们的DeCo的更全面的基准。 DeCo-B实现83.1%的P@.5和75.0%的mIoU,超过了以往最佳方法CCFormer(Lu等人,2025年),涵盖所有报告指标。 DeCo-L将结果进一步提高到85.3% P@.5和77.0% mIoU. 在更严格的IoU阈值下,DeCo的优越性保持不变. 与CCFormer相比,DeCo-L将P@5,P@7和P@9分别提高了2.9%,3.8%和4.2%,而OIOU和mIOU分别提高了1.8%和2.9%. 这些结果表明,建立具体任务模型和跨任务互补的好处也扩大到遥感情景下统一的多任务学习。

blocks.en: Main results for RRSIS on RRSIS-D. Different from natural referring segmentation, RRSIS requires language-guided pixel-level understanding under overhead viewpoints and complex object layouts, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating DeCo in remote sensing segmentation. As shown in Table 17 , DeCo-B achieves 77.3% P@.5, 78.3% oIoU, and 66.4% mIoU, outperforming the previous best method, MCD-Net ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , on the major evaluation metrics. Compared with the strongest prior results ( Lei et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , DeCo-L improves P@.5, P@.6, and P@.7 by 5.7%, 5.7%, and 3.8%, respectively, while increasing oIoU and mIoU by 1.6% and 3.8%. These results show that the decouple-to-couple design transfers effectively to remote sensing referring segmentation and provides more accurate region-level alignment.
blocks.zh: RRSIS关于RRSIS-D的主要结果。 RRSIS不同于自然参照分区,需要在高空角度和复杂的物体布局下进行语言引导像素水平的理解,使其成为在遥感分区中评价DeCo的具有挑战性的试验台。 如表17所示,DeCo-B实现77.3%的P@.5、78.3%的OIOU和66.4%的mIOU,在主要评价衡量标准上比以往最佳方法MCD-Net(Zhang等人,2026a)表现优异。 DeCo-L的性能进一步提高到81.3% P@.5,79.7% oIoU,68.9% mIoU. 与以往最强的成绩(Lei等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a)相比,DeCo-L将P@5,P@6和P@7分别提高了5.7%,5.7%和3.8%,同时将OIOU和mIOU增加了1.6%和3.8%. 这些结果表明,双对接设计有效地向遥感参照区划转移,并提供了更准确的区域一级协调。

blocks.en: Main results for RRSIS on RIS-LAD. Table 17 provides the comparison on the RIS-LAD test set. RIS-LAD is a challenging UAV-based benchmark with substantially longer textual expressions and complex small objects, which impose greater demands on fine-grained language understanding and precise spatial localization. Despite these challenges, DeCo-B achieves 51.1% P@.5, 50.3% oIoU, and 47.1% mIoU, outperforming the previous best method, SAARN ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , by 6.1%, 0.7%, and 5.4%, respectively. DeCo-L further improves these results to 56.1% P@.5, 54.8% oIoU, and 50.2% mIoU, while retaining its advantage under stricter IoU thresholds. Such substantial gains demonstrate the ability of DeCo to preserve semantic discrimination and spatial precision in challenging UAV scenarios with long referring expressions and small targets.
blocks.zh: RRSIS关于RIS-LAD的主要成果。 表17提供了RIS-LAD测试集的比较。 RIS-LAD是一个具有挑战性的基于无人驾驶飞行器的基准,其文字表达式和复杂的小对象要长得多,对精细的语言理解和精确的空间定位提出了更大的要求. 尽管存在这些挑战,DeCo-B取得了51.1%的P@.5、50.3%的OIOU和47.1%的mIOU,分别比以往的最佳方法SAARN(Ye等人,2026年)高6.1%、0.7%和5.4%。 DeCo-L进一步提高了这些成绩,达到56.1%的P@.5、54.8%的OIOU和50.2%的mIOU,同时在更严格的IOU阈值下保持其优势. 这些实质性成果表明,DeCo有能力在使用长的提法和小目标挑战无人驾驶航空器情景时保持语义歧视和空间精确性。

blocks.en: Main results for RRSIS on RefDIOR. Table 17 presents the segmentation results on the RefDIOR test set. As a unified multi-task remote sensing benchmark, RefDIOR provides a challenging setting for jointly evaluating localization and segmentation. DeCo-B achieves 81.6% P@.5, 81.8% oIoU, and 71.6% mIoU, outperforming CCFormer ( Lu et al., 2025 ) by 1.5%, 0.9%, and 0.6%, respectively. DeCo-L further improves these results to 83.2% P@.5, 83.8% oIoU, and 73.4% mIoU, bringing impressive gains of 3.1%, 2.9%, and 2.4% over CCFormer, respectively. Together with the RSVG results on the same benchmark, all the improvements demonstrate that our decouple-to-couple paradigm is well suited to unified multi-task learning in remote sensing scenarios.

DeCo-B实现81.6%的P@5.、81.8%的OIOU和71.6%的MIOU,分别比CCFormer(Lu等人,2025年)高1.5%、0.9%和0.6%。 DeCo-L进一步提高了这些结果,达到83.2%的P@.5、83.8%的OIOU和73.4%的mIOU,分别比CCFormer提高了3.1%、2.9%和2.4%。 与同一项基准的RSVG结果一起,所有改进都表明,我们的双联模式非常适合在遥感情景下进行统一的多任务学习。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows qualitative results across diverse remote sensing benchmarks. DeCo reliably grounds the referred objects under optical, SAR, and UAV imagery, including small objects and relation-intensive expressions, while producing well-aligned localization boxes and segmentation masks. Overall, the above six quantitative results reveal that existing methods developed for natural images generally lag behind specialized remote sensing approaches, indicating a clear domain gap between the two scenarios. In contrast, DeCo consistently bridges this gap and achieves superior performance across various tasks and modalities. Moreover, existing remote sensing methods typically rely on full tuning, which introduces substantial optimization burden when processing high-resolution images. By adapting a frozen multimodal encoder with only lightweight trainable modules, DeCo demonstrates that parameter-efficient learning is also applicable to remote sensing while substantially reducing training costs. This property makes DeCo particularly attractive for high-resolution scenarios, where computational efficiency and visual understanding capability are both critical.
blocks.zh: 图4显示各种遥感基准的质量结果。 DeCo在光学、合成孔径雷达和无人驾驶飞行器图像,包括小物体和关系密集的表达方式下可靠地为上述物体打下基础,同时生产吻合的本地化箱和分区口罩。 总体而言,上述六项量化结果表明,为自然图像开发的现有方法一般落后于专门遥感方法,表明这两种情景之间明显存在域间差距。 与此形成对照的是,DeCo始终如一地弥合这一差距,并在各种任务和方式方面实现优异的业绩。 此外,现有的遥感方法通常依赖于全调,这在处理高分辨率图像时带来了巨大的优化负担。 DeCo通过改装一个只装有轻量级可培训模块的冷冻多式编码器,表明参数高效的学习也适用于遥感,同时大幅减少培训费用。 这个属性使得DeCo对高分辨率的情景特别有吸引力,其中计算效率和视觉理解能力都至关重要.

blocks.en: Effects of Task Decoupling and Prior Coupling. We further investigate the design choices of TSD and HPC in Table 18 . Removing TSD reduces the average performance to 75.6%. A straightforward alternative is to duplicate SimFPN for the localization and segmentation branches, which improves the average score to 76.3%, confirming the benefit of task-specific representations, but at the cost of substantially higher parameters and FLOPs. In comparison, TSD achieves the best average score of 76.6% with lower computational burden. Removing SWM from TSD decreases the score to 76.2%, further validating the importance of word conditioned feature decoupling. For prior coupling, removing HPC decreases the average score from 76.6% to 75.4%. Introducing only the textual prior improves it to 75.9%, whereas using only the mask-derived spatial prior yields a larger gain to 76.3%. In particular, the mask prior improves P@.5:.95 from 69.1% to 71.1%, highlighting the value of dense segmentation cues for precise localization. Combining both priors achieves the best overall performance of 76.6%, demonstrating that sentence-level semantics and mask-derived geometry provide complementary information for cross-task coupling.
blocks.zh: 任务脱钩和前置脱钩的效果 。 我们进一步调查表18中TSD和HPC的设计选择。 取消TSD将使平均性能降低到75.6%. 一个直截了当的替代办法是复制SimFPN的本地化和分区化分支,将平均分数提高到76.3%,证实了特定任务表述的好处,但代价是大幅提高参数和FLOP. 相比之下,TSD在计算负担较低的情况下达到76.6%的最佳平均得分. 将SWM从TSD中移除后,得分降至76.2%,进一步验证了文字条件特征脱钩的重要性. 就先前的配合而言,取消高氯苯将平均得分从76.6%降至75.4%。 仅采用文字上的前置法,就将其提高到75.9%,而仅使用口罩产生的空间上的前置法,收益就更大,达到76.3%。 特别是,前面的面具提高了P@5:.95,从69.1%提高到71.1%,突出了密集的分块提示对精确本地化的价值. 将前科和前科结合起来,可以实现76.6%的最佳总体性能,表明句子层次的语义学和面具衍生的几何学为跨任务组合提供了补充信息.

blocks.en: Effects of the LoRA Scaling Factor α \alpha . We then study the effect of the scaling factor α \alpha while fixing the rank to r = 32 r=32 . As shown in Table 19 , the overall performance gradually improves as α \alpha increases from 8 to 32, reaching the best average score of 76.6% at α = 32 \alpha=32 . A smaller α \alpha may under-adapt the frozen multimodal encoder, whereas an excessively large value can amplify the low-rank residual and disturb the pretrained representations. This is also reflected by the performance drop to 75.2% when α = 128 \alpha=128 . These results suggest that a moderate adaptation strength is crucial for preserving pretrained knowledge while sufficiently adjusting multimodal representations to the downstream grounding objectives. We therefore set α = 32 \alpha=32 by default.

blocks.en: Grounding across Expression Lengths. Since longer linguistic expressions typically contain richer attributes and relational cues, we examine the robustness of DeCo to expression length. According to the number of words, the 9,602 samples in G-Ref (test-u) are divided into short ( L ≤ 6 L\leq 6 ), middle ( 6 < L ≤ 12 6<L\leq 12 ), and long ( L > 12 L>12 ) groups, containing 3,415, 4,858, and 1,329 expressions, respectively. As shown in Figure 5 , we first evaluate the default ablation configuration, DeCo-B under the standard setting (DeCo-B-Standard), which remains stable across different lengths, with no consistent degradation as expressions become longer. Notably, the long group even achieves the highest RES scores of 75.1% oIoU and 75.6% mIoU. We further examine our strongest model, DeCo-L under the mixed setting (DeCo-L-Mixed), and observe the same trend. Its REC P@.5 changes only from 93.0% for short expressions to 92.1% for long ones, while P@.5:.95 varies from 84.2% to 83.2%. Meanwhile, RES oIoU increases from 82.2% to 83.7%. These results indicate that DeCo is largely insensitive to expression length and preserves both localization and segmentation quality under increasingly complex descriptions. This robustness is further illustrated by the representative examples in Figure 6 . For each length group, we select examples from all eight splits where both REC and RES achieve high IoU. Specifically, we use IoU thresholds of 0.98, 0.95, and 0.90 for short, middle, and long expressions, respectively, to account for the increasing difficulty of processing longer expressions. DeCo accurately identifies the referred targets across different expression lengths, highlighting its consistent performance regardless of expression length.

blocks.en: Visualization of Task-specific Feature Preferences and Decoupling. To further confirm the representation conflict between REC and RES, we visualize the third-level ( l = 3 l=3 ) feature responses of different models using Grad-CAM ( Selvaraju et al., 2017 ) . As illustrated in Figure 7 , we first compare the task-oriented models and observe different activation patterns: LoM tends to focus on sparse yet discriminative regions that facilitate object localization, whereas SoM distributes its attention more broadly over the target extent to support dense segmentation. This observation provides qualitative evidence that REC and RES favor distinct visual cues. When both objectives share the same representation, as in DoM, the resulting activations tend to either resemble those of one dominant task or exhibit a mixture of the two task preferences. A similar behavior is observed in the shared feature 𝐕 l \mathbf{V}_{l} of DeCo before TSD, demonstrating the limitation of directly coupling different objectives within a common representation. In contrast, after TSD, the decoupled localization-oriented feature 𝐕 l l ​ o ​ c \mathbf{V}^{loc}_{l} recovers the sparse discriminative responses preferred by REC, while the segmentation-oriented feature 𝐕 l s ​ e ​ g \mathbf{V}^{seg}_{l} highlights more complete target regions for RES. Notably, the salient words highlighted in red cover diverse discriminative semantics, including object categories, actions, and descriptive modifiers, rather than being restricted to class attributes. This indicates that the salient-word selection can adaptively identify informative linguistic cues for task-specific feature modulation. These visualizations further support our motivation for decoupling shared representations according to the distinct visual interests of REC and RES before cross-task coupling.

blocks.en: Failure Cases. Figure 8 shows representative failure cases of DeCo with BEiT3-L across eight splits under the mixed setting. We identify a sample as a failure case when its IoU is below 0.3 for both REC and RES. Our analysis reveals three major sources of failure: (i) Annotation ambiguity occurs when multiple visual instances can match the same referring expression, making the single-target annotation inherently non-unique; (ii) Annotation errors arise when the annotated target does not match the textual description, indicating noise in the ground truth rather than a genuine model failure; (iii) Model limitations account for cases where the prediction requires complex logical relations or relies on subtle and fine-grained visual cues. These observations suggest that some apparent failures originate from annotation ambiguity and noise, while the remaining examples highlight the need for stronger relational reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding.
blocks.zh: 失败案例。 图8显示在混合环境下,DeCo与BEiT3-L的典型故障案例分为8个。 我们确定一个样本为失败案例,因为REC和RES的IoU低于0.3。 我们的分析揭示了三种主要的失败源:(一) 当多个视觉事件可以匹配相同的引用表达时,便会出现注释模糊性,使得单目标注释本质上是非独一无二的;(二) 当附加注释的目标与文字描述不匹配时,会出现注释错误,表明地面真实中的噪声而不是真正的模型故障;(三) 模型限制考虑到预测需要复杂的逻辑关系或依赖微妙和精细的视觉提示的情况. 这些意见表明,一些明显的失败源于注释模糊和噪音,而其余的例子则突出表明,需要加强关系推理和精细的视觉理解。

blocks.en: Open-World Generalization. Despite the impressive in-domain performance of DeCo, real-world application requires robust generalization beyond the training distribution. We therefore examine its open-world cognition on unseen images from diverse scenarios, including optical , SAR , indoor , anime , pixel art , comics , computer graphics , painting , sketch , and artwork . Free-form referring expressions involving spatial position , visual attributes , inter-object relations , and logical reasoning are used to assess fine-grained vision-language alignment under substantial distribution shifts. As shown in Figure 9 , DeCo generalizes well across these diverse visual domains. It can distinguish similar instances by fine-grained attributes, localize small targets, and resolve relational descriptions, while remaining effective under strong style shifts from anime and pixel art to sketch and classical artwork. These results indicate that the learned vision-language correspondence transfers beyond the benchmark distributions and retains semantic discrimination and relational reasoning in the wild.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Works
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和未来工程

blocks.en: Despite its strong performance and generalization, DeCo still has several limitations that motivate further investigation. First, the current formulation assumes single-target referring expressions. The localization branch employs a single object query, while the mask-to-box operation derives only one enclosing box through global spatial extrema, making DeCo less suitable for expressions referring to multiple objects or spatially disconnected regions. A natural extension is to introduce multiple object queries together with instance-aware mask decomposition, where each instance mask is independently converted into a spatial prior. This would enable multiple referred objects to be separately represented, localized, and coupled across REC and RES. Second, although HPC adaptively integrates semantic and mask-derived spatial priors, the quality of the latter still depends on the intermediate segmentation prediction. In challenging cases with severe occlusion, tiny objects, or ambiguous expressions, inaccurate masks may provide imperfect geometric cues. Exploring uncertainty-aware prior estimation or more flexible bidirectional interaction between localization and segmentation could further improve the robustness of cross-task coupling. Finally, parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces the number of trainable parameters, but inference still requires forwarding through the frozen multimodal encoder, which may remain computationally demanding for very high-resolution imagery. Future work could investigate token pruning, dynamic-resolution processing, or lightweight multimodal encoders to further reduce inference cost.
